issues: Verdict: the claim says 7012 'must be bought'. That is categorically false, because the PDF is free to read and download. 'MISLEADING' understates it, so the verdict is changed to FALSE. The true part (a paid edition also exists) now sits in the correction.

The correction says the free PDF needs 'a free IEEE account'. No source read confirms this. The IEEE GET Program page says only that the program website 'will require users accept of the Terms and Conditions of Use before access to the standard(s) PDF file is permitted'. The Xplore metadata has a getProgramTermsAccepted flag. Neither mentions an account. This is the same finding as the myterms-1 verdict on getProgramNote. The account clause is removed.

It is confirmed in the live Accuris store listing, which the 'Purchase' button on the IEEE SA standard page links to (store.accuristech.com/ieee/products/vendor_id/7192).
